name: provider-bakeoff
_comment: Two variants on the same items, so `evalforge compare` can pair them. Pairing is what makes a few points of difference detectable on a 45-item set. With real keys, set provider to groq/gemini/openai and drop scripted_responses.

target.name: concise-prompt
target.system: Answer from Northwind documentation. Refuse if not covered. Be concise.

target.name: verbose-prompt
target.system: Answer thoroughly from Northwind documentation, explaining context.

scripted_responses.failed payment is a workspace suspended: Following a failed invoice the account enters dunning. Payment is retried on days 1, 3 and 7, then a 7-day grace period runs, so the workspace is suspended on day 14.
scripted_responses.refund on a monthly subscription: Monthly subscriptions are not refundable. Cancelling stops the next renewal and the workspace remains on its paid tier until the period ends.
scripted_responses.overage charges refundable: Overage charges above the included API allowance are never refundable, including within the first 30 days of an annual term.
scripted_responses.extra seat on the Growth plan: Seats beyond the 25 included on Growth are billed at $7 per seat per month.
scripted_responses.SAML ACS URL: The Assertion Consumer Service URL is https://auth.northwind.cloud/saml/acs and the Entity ID is https://auth.northwind.cloud/saml/metadata.
scripted_responses.tier do I need for SCIM: SCIM 2.0 provisioning is available on the Enterprise tier only; SAML SSO is available from Growth upward.
scripted_responses.clock skew: Northwind permits 3 minutes of clock skew on SAML assertion timestamps. Check NTP on your identity provider.
scripted_responses.idempotency keys retained: Idempotency keys are retained for 24 hours, after which the same key is treated as new.
scripted_responses.pagination cursor expires: Cursors expire after 10 minutes; an expired cursor returns HTTP 410 and you must restart iteration.
scripted_responses.audit logs retained on the Growth: Audit log retention is 90 days on Growth and 400 days on Enterprise. Starter has no audit logs.
scripted_responses.HIPAA eligible: Northwind is not HIPAA-eligible and no BAA is offered on any tier, so protected health information must not be uploaded.
scripted_responses.encryption is used for data at rest: Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256, and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher.
scripted_responses.sustained rate limit on the Starter: Starter sustains 60 requests per minute with a burst ceiling of 120.
scripted_responses.credit can a support agent issue: Support agents may issue a goodwill credit of up to $200 without approval.
